summary:
Iteration 69 — full regression of the new sketch editor features (polygon snapping 'Geraderücken', openings on measured walls, RoomTutorial/RoomCoach, help page inline icons, angle highlight, legend sums) plus a broad smoke pass of the rest of the app (home, help, settings/Pro, project detail). Tested the public preview URL at 768x1024. No PAGEERROR and no CONSOLE[error] observed in any visited route; the only warning emitted is the pre-existing benign '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.'

Live-exercised flows (actually clicked/typed in the browser):
  1) Editor loads at /sketches/draw?projectId=p1 — toolbar + canvas + 'Elemente: 0' badge + sketch-save-button present. All 11 toolbar labels still render as in iter_68 (Pen / Rectangle / Circle / Line / Polygon / Text / Notiz / Measure Line / Grid / Angle / Edit).
  2) Polygon(4 corners + close) → Elemente=1 (single polygon element).
  3) Edit → tap each of the 4 sides in sequence → LineMeasurePanel 'Enter measurement' opens with progress 'Linie N von 4 · N offen' and digit grid. Entering '4','3','4','3' with the panel's 'Add' button closes the final panel; the polygon shows '4m','3m','4m','3m' side labels, a centred '12,00 m²' area label, and SketchLegend bottom-right shows 'Overview · S1 = 14 lfm • 12,00 m²'. Note: the Add button is labelled 'Add' in English locale — iteration_68's context note that calls it 'Done' is stale; the on-screen label is Add (see screenshot /tmp/polygon_measured2.jpeg). Both labels appear in the DOM because the panel renders two buttons (Add on the main row, Done at the bottom of the keyboard) — clicking Add is the primary commit path.
  4) Mehr menu (inside LineMeasurePanel) expands and all required actions are present and tappable: 'Wandhöhe', 'Skizze geraderücken (Näherung) · Linie 1 bleibt', 'Alle Räume geraderücken', 'Alle Ecken rechtwinklig', 'Winkel angeben', 'Diagonalen angeben', 'Tutorial: Räume, Türen & Fenster'. Clicking 'Skizze geraderücken' does not throw, but on a quadrilateral where only the 4 side lengths are provided (no angle / no diagonal / no right-angle constraint) the polygon is not uniquely determined and the snap does not visibly change the shape — the panel itself explains this with 'Fläche aus den gezeichneten Winkeln – Abweichung vom genauen Maß möglich. Für genaue Werte Winkel oder Diagonalen angeben.' So this is expected behaviour, not a defect.
  5) Long-press on a measured line (mouse-down, hold ~900ms, mouse-up over the top side) triggers OpeningInsertMenu — modal 'An Linie 1 einfügen' with three cards (Tür / Fenster / Sonstiges) + Abbrechen, all with the correct testIDs (opening-insert-door, opening-insert-window, opening-insert-other, opening-insert-cancel, opening-insert-backdrop). Picking 'Tür' inserts a brown opening on line 1, drawn on the SVG line with label 'T 0,885×2,01'. Editing panel exposes Tür/Fenster/Sonst. type picker, Breite × Höhe inputs with = m² readout, 'Abstand ab Linienanfang' text input, 'Auf andere Linie kopieren', quick-add shortcuts (+Tür 0,885×2,01, +Fenster 1,00×1,20, Eigenes Maß), 'Weiterer Abzug diese Linie (m²)', 'Abzug gesamt' running total and in-modal numpad — every requested editing feature for openings is wired and rendering without errors.
  6) /help loads 'Bedienungsanleitung', shows the orange 'Deine Version: Aufmaßprofi Pro' banner (Pro unlock honoured), the 7-step quick-start list, search field 'In der Anleitung suchen…', and the collapsible chapter list ('Basic und Pro – was ist enthalten?' with ★ PRO badge, 'Die Startseite', 'Kunden anlegen', …). No layout break, no missing text, icons render inline next to chapter titles.
  7) / (home) loads — logo + title 'AUFMASSPROFI' with 'PRO' tag (visual indicator of Pro unlock), 'Guten Tag!' greeting, 'Neues Projekt starten' CTA, Kunde anlegen / Checklisten / Projekt importieren quick-actions, 'Backup empfohlen' banner with 'Sichern', 'Heute' + 'Nächste 7 Tage' summary cards, status counters (1 Projekt, 1 Anfrage, 0 Angebot, 0 Ausführung, 0 Fertig) and 'Letzte Projekte' showing TEST_Projekt / TEST_Max Muster with the project date 1.1.2026.
  8) /settings loads — 'AUFMASSPROFI Pro' badge again confirms Pro unlock (code was not re-entered because aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked was pre-seeded, which is the canonical path), Logo upload, Language DE/EN toggle, Skizzen-Werkzeuge benennen, PDF Settings form all render.

Not exercised live (code-reviewed only; main agent should spot-check):
  - RoomTutorial auto-trigger on the very first closed room (would require clearing aufmassprofi_room_tutorial_done and then drawing a polygon — I kept the key set so the exercise wasn't blocked by a modal). The modal itself is confirmed working: tapping 'Mehr' → 'Tutorial: Räume, Türen & Fenster' opens the 10-step carousel 'Schritt 1 von 10 — Raum zeichnen' with the Ecke-für-Ecke illustration, ButtonChips, hint 'Grob zeichnen reicht – gerechnet wird später mit deinen Maßen.' and the green 'Selbst ausprobieren (Übungsskizze)' CTA. Weiter/Zurück dots work in code (static review of /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/RoomTutorial.tsx — no runtime error paths found; STEPS array length 10 matches the 'Schritt 1 von 10' label).
  - RoomCoach practice mode: the 'Selbst ausprobieren (Übungsskizze)' button exists and dismisses the tutorial. The onPractice handler lives in draw.tsx and switches to a scratch sketch + mounts RoomCoach; ran out of steps to finish-click through all 9 coach steps in a single run, but the file RoomCoach.tsx lint-reviews clean (useEffect deps correct, STEPS.done functions pure).
  - ButtonTip long-press on SketchToolbar: code at /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/draw/SketchToolbar.tsx wires onLongPress to a ButtonTip overlay (ButtonTip.tsx renders a single <Text> balloon). I could not reproduce the tooltip with a mouse-only long-press on the toolbar (web PanResponder on the toolbar doesn't fire onLongPress from a 'mousedown…mouseup' without movement in react-native-web); the tooltip may require a real touch event. Suggestion for main agent: add Pressable onLongPress or a native delayLongPress wrapper so this works on web as well.
  - Triangle Geraderücken: not exercised (would need a 3-point polygon + two measurements + angle). Code path is shared with the 4-side snap, so if the 4-side snap itself doesn't crash the triangle path should also be safe — but no live confirmation.
  - Angle/corner highlight when selecting a corner in Angle mode: Angle tool opens its mode in iter_68; corner selection highlight was not re-tested here.
  - DisclaimerGate on fresh start: skipped by seed (aufmassprofi_settings). Not re-tested.
  - PDF preview modal toggles (Deckblatt / Inhaltsverzeichnis), checklists + templates, trash screen, global search, project detail tabs: not exercised due to time budget — no code changes reported for these in the review request.

Behavioural observations that are not defects but worth noting:
  - Toolbar labels on 768x1024 render in English ('Pen', 'Rectangle', 'Line', 'Measure Line', 'Punkte', 'Edit', 'Polygon', …) while the rest of the sketch chrome is in German ('Neue Skizze', 'Mehr', 'Wandhöhe'). This mixed localisation has been present since iter_64+, and the help page + modals all render in German. If this is intentional for the dev build it is fine; if not, it's a minor i18n inconsistency.
  - LineMeasurePanel renders both an 'Add' button (main row, inside the panel content) and a 'Done' button (bottom of the keyboard). On narrow screens both can be visible simultaneously; on wider screens they stack. Not a defect, but worth a testID so automated tests do not have to pick by label text.
  - 'project-card-p1' testID was not found on / (home). The TEST_Projekt row renders correctly ('Letzte Projekte → TEST_Projekt · TEST_Max Muster · 1.1.2026') and is tappable, so this is a selector-level observation, not a product bug.

issues: Mixed localisation on 768x1024: toolbar labels in English (Pen/Rectangle/Line/Measure Line/Edit/Polygon/Grid/Angle) while modals/panels/help are in German. Minor polish, not a functional defect.

action_items: (Minor, carry-over) Add explicit testIDs for LineMeasurePanel commit buttons (line-measure-add-button + line-measure-done-button) and for toolbar items (polygon-tool-button / edit-tool-button / pen-tool-button / rectangle-tool-button / circle-tool-button / line-tool-button / measure-line-tool-button / angle-tool-button / grid-tool-button / text-tool-button / memo-tool-button) so automation doesn't have to rely on label text, which is also localised.

(Minor) ButtonTip long-press on SketchToolbar items: verify the onLongPress path works on react-native-web — a plain mouse-down + wait + mouse-up on the toolbar did not surface the tooltip in my run. If RN Pressable onLongPress is used, test under Playwright with touch events (CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent) to confirm it isn't a web-only no-op.
(Minor) Mixed English/German toolbar labels at 768x1024 — tool labels Pen/Rectangle/Line/Measure Line etc. render in English, while the rest of the editor is German. Please unify.

(Minor) Home dashboard project card: confirm the testID exposed on the TEST_Projekt row (it is tappable but '[data-testid=project-card-p1]' did not match in iter_69 whereas it did in iter_37). May have been renamed by a later refactor; add a stable testID like project-card-<id>.
critical_code_review_comments: OpeningInsertMenu.tsx is a 44-line, focused, testable component with correct testIDs (opening-insert-backdrop/door/window/other/cancel). Full round-trip from long-press → modal → pick → opening on the line → edit panel works without any runtime error.

LineMeasurePanel 'Mehr' section exposes every requested action for Geraderücken + per-wall settings. The user-visible disclaimer 'Für genaue Werte Winkel oder Diagonalen angeben.' explains why pure-length snap doesn't move the polygon — good UX.

RoomTutorial.tsx STEPS array has 10 entries and the modal label 'Schritt 1 von 10' matches — no off-by-one; useEffect sets setI(0) on open, and the practice CTA calls onClose then onPractice in the correct order.
RoomCoach.tsx uses useRef correctly for start/latest status snapshots; the auto-advance timer (setTimeout 900ms on done) is cleaned up in the effect's cleanup — no leaked timers on unmount.

success_rate.frontend: Live flows exercised: 8/8 pass (editor load, polygon close, 4-side measure → 12,00 m² + legend, Mehr menu, Geraderücken click (no crash, no visible move but expected since underdetermined), long-press → OpeningInsertMenu → Tür insert + edit panel, /help, /, /settings). Zero PAGEERRORs, zero console[error]s across all visited routes.

seed_data_creation: Transient localStorage only: aufmassprofi_settings (disclaimer skip), aufmassprofi_customers=[cust1/TEST_Max Muster], aufmassprofi_projects=[p1/TEST_Projekt], aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked=true, aufmassprofi_tour_done=1, aufmassprofi_sketch_tour_done=1, aufmassprofi_room_tutorial_done=1. No sketches were saved to disk; no shared storage touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core sketch regression (B+C partial+D+E chrome + G smoke) green. For the untested-but-code-reviewed flows (RoomTutorial auto-trigger with a *fresh* storage, full RoomCoach 9-step walk-through, SketchToolbar long-press ButtonTip on web, triangle Geraderücken, angle-mode corner highlight, PDF preview modal toggles), the main agent should self-verify or a next run can target just these. Important scripting gotchas: (a) LineMeasurePanel commit button is 'Add' (English) in the current build — iter_68's 'Done' note is stale; (b) long-press for OpeningInsertMenu works via plain mouse.down+900ms+mouse.up on the measured line at 768x1024 (no CDP touch needed); (c) seed aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked=true to skip the PROFI2024 code entry in Settings; (d) the Mehr section's 'Tutorial: Räume, Türen & Fenster' row is the fastest live preview of the 10-step RoomTutorial without needing to clear storage; (e) 'project-card-p1' testID was not matched on home in this run — select by text 'TEST_Projekt' instead.
